quarantine.mr_name: ALT allele permutation with consistent remapping of dependent fields
preconditions: record has at least 2 ALT alleles (comma-separated)
at least one INFO or FORMAT field with Number=A, Number=R, or Number=G
quarantine.oracle: After permuting ALT alleles and remapping all dependent fields (GT allele indices, Number=A values per-ALT, Number=R values REF+ALT, Number=G genotype values), the resulting VCF record must represent the same set of variant alleles and produce identical biological interpretation. A spec-compliant parser must treat the original and permuted records as semantically equivalent.

evidence.quote: ALT: alternate base(s); comma-separated list of alternate non-reference alleles

GT: genotype, encoded as allele values separated by either of / or |, e.g. 0/1 or 1|0. The allele values are 0 for the reference allele (what is in the REF field), 1 for the first allele in ALT, 2 for the second allele in ALT, etc.
Number=A means one value for each alternate allele; Number=R means one value for each allele including the reference; Number=G means one value for each possible genotype
